# Benford Lens 1.0.0

Benford Lens is a local-first desktop application for exploring first- and second-digit
distributions in CSV and Excel data. Analysis remains on your computer; the application has no
login, telemetry, cloud analysis, or online upload path.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Windows x64 | `Benford-Lens-1.0.0-windows-x64.msi` | Per-user installation with a Start menu shortcut and standard uninstall |
| Windows x64 | `Benford-Lens-1.0.0-windows-x64.zip` | Portable folder; extract the complete folder before running `benford-lens.exe` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `Benford-Lens-1.0.0-macOS-arm64.zip` | Extract, move **Benford Lens** to Applications if desired, and open it |

Each package has a matching `.sha256` file. These checksums let you confirm that a downloaded
file matches the asset produced by the release workflow.

## Important security notice

These packages are distributed without a paid platform signing identity.

- **Windows:** the executable and MSI are not Authenticode-signed. Microsoft Defender
  SmartScreen may show an unrecognized-app warning, and Smart App Control or an organization-managed
  policy may block the application.
- **macOS:** the app has an ad-hoc integrity signature but is not signed with Apple Developer ID
  and is not notarized. Gatekeeper may require you to try opening the app once and then choose
  **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.

Only continue when the download came from this repository and its SHA-256 checksum matches. The
project does not ask you to disable antivirus software or system-wide security protections.

## Highlights

- Explicit first-digit, second-digit, and combined analysis modes
- User-controlled preprocessing with before/after preview
- Advisory data-characteristics panel and optional MAD, Chi-square, KS, and sample-size references
- Position-aware original-row drill-down, search, and local CSV export
- Self-contained local HTML reports
- English, Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, French, and Russian interfaces

See the [user guide](https://github.com/internalforces/BenfordLens/blob/v1.0.0/docs/user-guide.md)
and [verification guide](https://github.com/internalforces/BenfordLens/blob/v1.0.0/docs/verification.md)
for the complete workflow and verification boundaries.
